code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypocalcemia. There is also monocytosis and basophilia. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic hypoxia, and a risk for infection or bleeding. Further clinical correlation and hematological evaluation are recommended.
